newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Prague wants to raise stake in utility.
newsitem.headline: Prague wants to raise stake in utility.

text.p: The city of Prague said on Monday it intends to increase its stake in Prague heating utility Prazska Teplarenska a.s. to 34 percent from a current 26 percent.
"City hall has approved the intention to increase (Prague's) stake in Prazska Teplarenska through the purchase of shares held by the firm DEOP," a city hall spokesman said.
DEOP, which holds 45 percnet in Teplarenska, is a subsidiary of power generating firm Elektrarny Opatovice a.s..
The spokesman did not reveal further details of the planned transaction, and DEOP officials were not immediately available for comment.
Germany's firm GESO holds 21 percent in the Prague-based heating utility. Teplarenska shares fell 52 crowns on the Prague Stock Exchange on Monday to 993.
